description: Identify which routes and chunks are responsible for bundle size growth between two loaded builds. Returns severity-ranked route findings, the top growing chunks, and an overall regression summary.

baselineBuildId.description: Baseline build ID from load_build_stats. Omit to list loaded builds.

currentBuildId.description: Current build ID from load_build_stats. Omit to list loaded builds.

limit.description: Max route findings and top growing chunks to return. Defaults to 10.

name: explain_growth
title: Explain Growth
